successors.name: Kingdom of France
successors.text: the French Vexin, annexed to the royal domain by Philip I in 1082

ledger.x: 990: the County of Vexin, with Pontoise, enters the record.
1063: Gauthier III de Gouy dies a prisoner of William the Bastard and his cousin Ralph IV of Valois succeeds him as count of the Vexin.

wars.name: Contest for the French Vexin between Philip I and William the Conqueror
wars.outcome: After Philip I's annexation of 1082 William, as duke of Normandy, 'pillaged the French Vexin in summer [1087], clashed with Philip I, and was fatally injured in the assault on Mantes'; the Vexin stayed with the crown.

certainty.note: A small feudal county drawn from Cliopatria's outline; the Epte is the western frontier with Normandy (911 treaty) but no page gives a surveyed line.
